text: {"lessons":["I will set a clear reason and price or portfolio condition for each trade, then revisit it instead of buying or holding on autopilot.","A profitable sale of Stock C did not prevent my account value from falling in that period, so I’ll judge decisions by their role in the whole portfolio, not one trade’s gain.","Short-term account swings are normal; I’ll avoid reacting to a single month’s result and keep my investing plan aligned with my ten-year apartment goal."]}
